We may consider him as the arch-rationalist, but that Pico thought otherwise is evident from one of his kabbalistic conclusions secundumopinionempropriam,of which we need only quote the latter half: .. ita Rabi Moyses Aegyptius in libro, qui a Latinis dicitur duxneutrorum,dum per superficialem verborum corticem videtur cum philosophia ambulare, per latentes profundi sensus intelligencias mysteria complectitur Cabal.149

The second possible source is Menalhem Recanati, whose commentary on the Torah Pico also had in Latin translation.
